text: No, the native forest on this property has not been completely lost. The analysis found that 13.5 hectares (3.9% of the property) experienced tree-cover loss in 2025. Of this area, 13.1 hectares were confirmed as native forest by Uruguay’s official forest map. While forest loss occurred in part of the property, the majority (around 96%) remains unaffected, and the lost area represents a small fraction of the total native forest on the property.
